nccl_spreadout_alltoallv_over.desc: LibPico external NCCL spread-out Alltoallv algorithm. This implementation uses NCCL point-to-point ncclSend/ncclRecv operations arranged in size - 1 communication rounds.

nccl_fanout_alltoallv_over.desc: LibPico external NCCL fan-out Alltoallv algorithm. This implementation posts all ncclSend/ncclRecv operations inside a single ncclGroupStart/ncclGroupEnd region.
